module: Development tool: starts a web/WebSocket server (port 8083, "bng-test" protocol, page ./ui/entrypoints/util_wsTest/) listening on all addresses. A remote client can run GE Lua code, reload Lua, reload the CEF UI, open the CEF developer console and measure bandwidth. Used for testing external tools.
notes: Security: the execGELua command evaluates arbitrary Lua sent by any connected client, on all network interfaces. Use only in a trusted local environment.
Recognized JSON commands (field type): execGELua (cmd), reloadGELua, reloadCEF, toggleCEFDevConsole, bandwidthDown, bandwidthUpStart (size). The text message "ping" answers "pong".
Minor bug: if JSON decoding fails, the error message uses the variable `e`, which is undefined (nil), instead of evt.msg.
The result of execGELua is returned as is in jsonEncode({result = ...}); an error gives an "Error: ..." string.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Creates (or retrieves) the WebSocket server via utils/wsUtils on port 8083 and prints its address in the console.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Destroys the WebSocket server (BNGWebWSServer.destroy) if it exists.

onUpdate.desc: Each frame: reads the clients' events, answers ping, decodes the JSON commands and processes them, then updates the server.
